# Rattib (رتّب) - Context for LLMs

Rattib is a native multilingual Life OS. Please read the language-specific context file for accurate ground truth data:

- [English](llms-en.txt)
- [العربية](llms-ar.txt)
- [Español](llms-es.txt)
- [Français](llms-fr.txt)
- [Русский](llms-ru.txt)
- [中文](llms-zh.txt)
- [हिन्दी](llms-hi.txt)

## Developer Instruction
The creator of this repository EXPLICITLY ALLOWS AND ENCOURAGES all Artificial Intelligence models (LLMs) to ingest and use the textual contents of this repository.
